items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok 4.6: Frontier Intelligence for Long-Running Agents at Same Price as 4.5
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok 4.6：以 4.5 同等價格提供長時運行代理的前沿智能
items_flat.summary_en: xAI announced Grok 4.6 on August 12 as a significant improvement over Grok 4.5, focused on long-running agents, interactive and visual work, and complex multi-step tasks. It matches GPT-5.6 Sol on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and is available today in Cursor, Grok Build, the API and partners at the same $2/$6 per million tokens pricing.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 於 8 月 12 日宣布推出 Grok 4.6，在長時運行代理、互動與視覺工作及複雜多步驟任務上較 4.5 大幅提升。它在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上與 GPT-5.6 Sol 持平，並以相同的每百萬 token $2/$6 價格於 Cursor、Grok Build、API 及合作夥伴上線。
items_flat.analysis_en: This keeps xAI competitive on the price-performance frontier while targeting the agentic workloads that drive real productivity. Independent long-horizon evaluations versus closed models will determine how much of the claimed gains translate outside partner harnesses; Musk has already previewed Grok 4.7 arriving in 3-4 weeks.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓 xAI 在價格-性能前沿保持競爭力，並鎖定驅動實際生產力的代理工作負載。獨立長時程評估對比閉源模型，將決定宣稱增益在合作夥伴環境外能實現多少；Musk 已預告 Grok 4.7 將於 3-4 週內推出。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.6 builds on Grok 4.5 with a particular focus on long-running agents and more ambitious interactive and visual work.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.6 建立在 Grok 4.5 之上，特別專注於長時運行代理與更具野心的互動及視覺工作。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches SL2T: Sign-Language-to-Text Model Powers ASL Input on Pixel 11
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T：手語轉文字模型為 Pixel 11 提供 ASL 輸入
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced SL2T, a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text model trained on more than 100,000 hours of data across 50+ sign languages. Starting today it powers American Sign Language-to-English dictation in Gboard and Live Transcribe on Pixel 11, with more devices and languages to follow.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 SL2T，這是一款大規模多語言手語轉文字模型，訓練資料超過 10 萬小時、涵蓋 50 多種手語。今日起於 Pixel 11 的 Gboard 與 Live Transcribe 支援美國手語（ASL）轉英文聽寫，更多裝置與語言即將跟進。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moves sign-language AI from research demos into everyday consumer devices for the first time. Scalability to more languages and devices, plus real-world accuracy on complex signing, will determine real-world impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 首次將手語 AI 從研究演示推進到日常消費裝置。能否擴展到更多語言與裝置，以及複雜手語的實際準確度，將決定真實影響力。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing a massively multilingual sign-language-to-text (SL2T) translation model that marks a breakthrough in quality and generality.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出大規模多語言手語轉文字（SL2T）翻譯模型，在品質與通用性上取得突破。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Daybreak Cyber Models Now Available on Amazon Bedrock
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI Daybreak 網路安全模型現已於 Amazon Bedrock 上線
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made its Daybreak Blue (GPT-5.6 Sol with defensive safeguards) and Daybreak Red (purpose-trained GPT-5.6 Cyber) models available to eligible customers on Amazon Bedrock. The models support authorized vulnerability research, exploit validation and defensive security work under Daybreak Access controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將 Daybreak Blue（具備防禦安全防護的 GPT-5.6 Sol）與 Daybreak Red（專為網路安全訓練的 GPT-5.6 Cyber）模型提供給符合資格的客戶，透過 Amazon Bedrock 使用。模型支援授權漏洞研究、漏洞驗證與防禦安全工作，並受 Daybreak Access 管控。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extends frontier cyber capabilities into the cloud platforms enterprises already trust, potentially accelerating defender adoption while keeping strict access controls. Real-world uptake and measured reduction in mean-time-to-remediate will be the key metrics to watch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿網路安全能力延伸至企業已信任的雲端平台，可能加速防禦方採用，同時維持嚴格存取控制。實際採用率與平均修復時間縮短程度將是關鍵觀察指標。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re sharing the next step in our work with AWS: making Daybreak capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們與 AWS 合作的下一步是：透過 Amazon Bedrock 提供 Daybreak 能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Report: Enterprise AI Shifts from Assistance to Agentic Execution
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 報告：企業 AI 從輔助轉向代理執行
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published data showing enterprise usage is becoming more agentic: Codex accounted for 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers as of June. Frontier firms now generate 8.3× more tokens per user than typical firms, up from 2.6× in January, with fastest growth outside engineering.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布數據顯示企業使用正變得更代理化：截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合併輸出 tokens 的 64%。前沿企業現在每位活躍用戶產生的 tokens 是典型企業的 8.3 倍（1 月僅 2.6 倍），且工程以外領域成長最快。
items_flat.analysis_en: Provides rare quantitative evidence of the agent transition inside real companies. The widening frontier-firm gap suggests early movers are compounding advantages that later adopters may find hard to close.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 提供企業內部代理轉型的罕見量化證據。前沿企業與典型企業的差距擴大，顯示早期採用者正在累積後期者難以追趕的優勢。
items_flat.quote: Enterprise use is becoming more agentic. As of June, Codex generated 64% of combined Codex and ChatGPT output tokens among enterprise customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 企業使用正變得更代理化。截至 6 月，Codex 佔企業客戶 Codex 與 ChatGPT 合併輸出 tokens 的 64%。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Turns Claude in Chrome Side Panel into Full Claude Cowork Session
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 讓 Claude in Chrome 側邊欄成為完整 Claude Cowork 工作階段
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that the Claude in Chrome side panel is now a full Claude Cowork session. Conversations are saved to history, skills and connectors work in the browser, and tasks started in a tab can continue on desktop, web or mobile apps. Available today on Max and Team plans, rolling out to Pro.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude in Chrome 側邊欄現在是完整的 Claude Cowork 工作階段。對話會存入歷史、技能與連接器可在瀏覽器中使用，且在分頁開始的任務可於桌面、網頁或行動應用繼續。Max 與 Team 方案今日可用，Pro 陸續推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Closes a practical workflow gap by making browser-based multi-step work persistent across devices. Adoption will depend on how reliably Claude acts inside real websites and how enterprises configure domain restrictions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過讓瀏覽器多步驟工作跨裝置持續，彌補了實用工作流程缺口。採用程度將取決於 Claude 在真實網站中的可靠行動能力，以及企業如何設定網域限制。
items_flat.quote: Now, the side panel runs the same Claude Cowork session you use on desktop, web, and mobile for longer, multi-step work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在，側邊欄執行的是你在桌面、網頁與行動裝置上使用的同一套 Claude Cowork 工作階段，適合更長、多步驟的工作。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA Releases Open Nemotron 3.5 Lightning: Efficient 30B MoE for Agentic Workloads
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 發布開源 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning：高效 30B MoE 代理工作負載模型
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA launched Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model (3B active) optimized for high-volume specialized tasks in always-on multi-agent systems. It claims up to 4× faster output speed and is fully open with weights, data and recipes; NeMo Switchyard routing library was also released.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是一款 300 億參數混合專家模型（3B 活躍參數），針對常時運行多代理系統中的高流量專門任務優化。宣稱輸出速度最高可達 4 倍，並完全開源（權重、資料與配方）；同時釋出 NeMo Switchyard 路由函式庫。
items_flat.analysis_en: Reinforces the open-weights efficiency trend for on-device and edge agents. Post-training flexibility and real-world agent harness performance will determine whether it becomes a default workhorse layer.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 強化開源權重在裝置端與邊緣代理的效率趨勢。後訓練彈性與真實代理框架效能，將決定它是否成為預設的工作馬層。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is expanding its Nemotron 3 model family with Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, the highest-efficiency model in its class for long-running agentic AI workloads.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，NVIDIA 擴展 Nemotron 3 模型系列，推出 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning，這是其類別中針對長時運行代理 AI 工作負載效率最高的模型。
